integrity: Analytic proof establishes all sizes/exponents; finite rational and numerical checks are corroborative. Publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Only unweighted finite cycles and real continuous-time p-heat (1<p<infinity); no fixed-time sharp global sensitivity or general weighted-graph classification. The initial-derivative instability is not a claim of infinite finite-time gain.
title: Cycle \(p\)-heat: individual Lipschitz contraction and sharp two-input instability
